item.title: Lions beat Hull to claim fourth straight away win
item.description: Millwall were 3-1 winners at Hull City in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon. Jake Cooper, Mihailo Ivanovic and Josh Coburn were on target as The Lions claimed a fourth straight away win to consolidate their place in the Sky Bet Championship's top six. Alex Neil made one change in his original XI named at the MKM Stadium, with Danny McNamara replacing Ryan Leonard, who missed out altogether, whilst Will Smallbone made a first matchday squad appearance since October on the bench. item.title: Goalscoring duo speak from MKM Stadium
item.description: The Lions' attacking duo of Mihailo Ivanovic and Josh Coburn spoke to Millwall TV+ following the 3-1 win over Hull City on Saturday afternoon. Ivanovic scored his eighth of the campaign to put Alex Neil's side back in front at the MKM Stadium, whilst Coburn's sixth of 2025/26 ensured three crucial points in the battle for the top six.
